event_records.description: The permit application is under review by the Permit Authority. No decision has been made yet.

applicant.name: Applicant
applicant.persona_brief:
You are Applicant.
The Applicant has submitted a permit application to the relevant authority and is awaiting a decision. They have no special influence or inside knowledge about the decision process.

permit_authority.name: Permit Authority
permit_authority.persona_brief:
You are Permit Authority.
The Permit Authority is the organization responsible for reviewing and approving or denying permit applications. They have standard procedures and a backlog of applications. They have not yet made a decision on this application.

resolution.question: Will the permit get approved by the end of August?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that the Permit Authority has communicated an approval decision to the Applicant before 2026-08-31T17:00:00-05:00. Otherwise resolve NO at that cutoff.
